mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id, name, CAST(path AS text) AS path FROM department WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND NOT deleted ORDER BY path
SELECT id, parent_id, name, CAST(path AS text) AS path FROM department WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND NOT deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO department (id, tenant_id, parent_id, name, path, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{parentId}, #{name}, CAST(#{path} AS ltree), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{actor}, #{actor})
mapper.update: UPDATE department SET name = #{name}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND NOT deleted

UPDATE department SET path = CASE WHEN id = #{id} THEN CAST(#{newPath} AS ltree) ELSE CAST(#{newPath} AS ltree) || subpath(path, nlevel(CAST(#{oldPath} AS ltree))) END, parent_id = CASE WHEN id = #{id} THEN CAST(#{parentId} AS uuid) ELSE parent_id END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND path <@ CAST(#{oldPath} AS ltree) AND NOT deleted
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM department WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND parent_id = #{id} AND NOT deleted
